verdict.line: You lose if you let fights run long into his Darkness Rise stacks and W shield; you win if you burst with W and Q then disengage before his third hit lands.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's Passive (Darkness Rise) rewards him for staying in the fight — three landed hits grant a damage aura and Move Speed — while his W (Indestructible) banks the damage he's already taken into a heal, so every extra second of a trade compounds in his favor. Illaoi's entire kit (Q tentacle burst, W leap, E spirit echo) is built to front-load damage, which means she wins the first three seconds of a fight and loses the next ten. The 46.5% win rate over 1143 games reflects a matchup that's close on paper but punishes greedy extended trades hard.

theirWindow.when: after his 3rd auto or spell hits you
theirWindow.what: Darkness Rise is live: he gets a damage aura and bonus Move Speed, so the fight escalates against you. Disengage before this threshold, not after you're already losing the trade.

yourWindow.when: right after he uses Q or E
yourWindow.what: Obliterate (Q, CD 8/7/6/5/4s) and Death's Grasp (E, CD 16/14/12/10/8s) are both his primary threats and both go on real cooldown. Step in with W (Harsh Lesson) and Q (Tentacle Smash) while he has nothing to answer with.

powerCurve.note: W shield and E pull come online

start.why: 45.2% win rate over 884 games and the highest pick rate (59.1%) — the lane sustain and early trade damage matter more here than Doran's Shield's flat mitigation.

boots.why: 43.7% win rate over 1047 games at 75.9% pick — the tenacity directly counters his E (Death's Grasp) pull chaining into follow-up damage.

core.why: First item in the top build path (44.9% over 78 games) — the armor shred widens your burst windows before his passive aura kicks in.
Second in the core path — the proc on your W leap adds burst without costing you tempo in the short trade windows you're forced into.
Caps the top-picked 3-item path — cuts his magic damage and, critically, cuts the healing he gets off his W's stored shield, which is exactly the sustain op.gg flags as his win condition.

situational.when: he's landing R (Realm of Death) reliably and you need to survive the burst that follows it
his magic damage is snowballing and you need the shield plus magic resist to keep trading
you're ahead on tempo and want to push the short-trade burst advantage even harder

runes.keystoneWhy: Since extended fights favor him, Grasp's sustain lets you hold lane presence through the early poke phase instead of being forced to all-in before your items come online.

summoners.why: 47.5% win rate over the sample, the highest of the three options — Exhaust directly blunts the burst from his passive aura and lets you survive or avoid his R (Realm of Death) engage.

playing.title: Trade burst, not duration
playing.detail: Lead with W (Harsh Lesson) leap into Q (Tentacle Smash) tentacle damage, then disengage. Standing in prolonged autos is exactly what lets his passive and W heal take over.

playing.title: E him before he commits
playing.detail: Use E (Test of Spirit) at its 900 range to start the spirit damage transfer on your terms, before he closes in with Q or pulls you with E (Death's Grasp).

playing.title: Never R into his up R
playing.detail: Your R (Leap of Faith) spawns tentacles around you, but if his R (Realm of Death, CD 140/120/100/90/80s) drags you away afterward, every tentacle is left behind and useless. Hold your R until his is down.

playing.title: Watch his 3rd hit for passive
playing.detail: Track his autos and spells landing on you — the 3rd stacks Darkness Rise for a damage aura and Move Speed. Pull out right before that threshold, not after.

playing.title: Concede duels levels 3-8
playing.detail: His W shield and E pull are online by then and the head-to-head sits at 46.5% over 1143 games. Prioritize tentacle zoning and farm over forcing all-ins in this window.

playing.title: Punish his Q and E cooldowns
playing.detail: Obliterate (CD 8/7/6/5/4s) and Death's Grasp (CD 16/14/12/10/8s) are both long early. The moment either is used, step in with W while he has no answer.

playing.title: Build into his sustain, not around it
playing.detail: Spirit Visage isn't just magic resist here — it directly cuts the healing his W banks into, which is the specific mechanic that makes him win long fights.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reading of why those numbers hold — the passive timing, the ult sequencing, the trade windows — is my own analysis of the ability interactions, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Mordekaiser has the upper hand in prolonged fights due to his (W) and (P) even when your [E] lands successfully. Mordekaiser will always win if he uses his (R) after you use [R], as all of your tentacles will be outside the Death Realm. Never use your [R] before (R), and use your [E] to harass him without being hit by (E).
